start.text: A low driftwood stool beside the harbormaster's door, a deep dent worn into its seat. Someone big sat here for a lot of years.

told.text: Dunstan's stool; it has to be. The dent is a big man's shape.
Mara has swept round it, not under it. It hasn't moved in two weeks.

chose.text: Dunstan's stool. Someone has wiped it down and set it square to the harbor, facing north, the way he walked.
Waiting, or ready to be put away. You can't tell which, and you suspect Mara can't either.

gull_home.text: Dunstan's stool. A thumb-sized whittled gull sits on the seat now, its beak turned north.
Mara has put it where he'll see it first.

gull_burned.text: Two cups stand on an upturned crate beside the stool: one drained, one full and long cold, a skin grown over it.
The dent in the seat is a big man's shape. Nobody in Saltmarrow could tell you whose.
The stool is still set square to the harbor, facing north. Mara wipes it down every morning and couldn't tell you why.
